verdict.rationale: Outlook documents Inbox rules that handle incoming mail automatically, including forwarding specific messages. That covers the rule-based routing half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows assigning a conversation to a teammate or recording explicit ownership; send-on-behalf delegation and follow-up flags are adjacent features, not assignment. missing for 10: conversation assignment to teammates, explicit ownership/assignee tracking, team-level (shared) routing rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit

citations.quote: Apps can set up [Inbox rules](/en-us/graph/api/resources/messagerule) to promptly handle incoming messages and reduce email clutter.
Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages
